description: Build mcp_tool_schema_patterns.py per Appendix B of the spec. Pure library module — no daemons, no network, no DB writes, no imports of protected modules. Detects architectural patterns in MCP server tool definitions: (a) progressive-disclosure (≤4 high-level tools), (b) brute-force enumeration (≥20 tools), (c) hybrid. Must: (1) export analyze_tool_schema(tool_definitions: list) -> {pattern: str, tool_count: int, evidence: dict}, (2) include Cloudflare attribution docstring, (3) compile patterns at module load, (4) include if __name__ == '__main__' self-smoke with three known-good inputs. Feeds future context_efficiency signal. Reference: Cloudflare enterprise MCP reference architecture, blog.cloudflare.com, 2026-04-14.
